titel: They Tapped A Soviet Cable Underwater

szenen.text: The U.S. *tapped* a Soviet cable on the ocean floor.
It lay in the *Sea of Okhotsk.*
The cable linked a Soviet naval base to *headquarters.*
U.S. divers placed a *recording device* on it.
Tapes were *collected* and replaced in secret.
Then a former NSA employee *sold* the secret to the KGB.
The device ended up *on display* in Russia. Could it happen today?

caption: The U.S. wiretapped a Soviet cable on the seafloor until a spy gave it away. Could it happen today? Send this to someone who doesn't believe it. AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.
